english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for eating food, and it also works with resources, tape, or money when context makes the metaphor clear.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 zo2 go3 ping4 gwo2 sin1

english.note: Use this for the ordinary act of eating, the most common everyday sense.
Use this when the subject, usually an animal, is eating or grazing rather than being given food.

exampleSentences.english: This cow can feed on grass.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 zek3 ngau4 ho2 ji5 sik6 cou2

english.note: Use this when “have” refers to food or a meal, such as having breakfast; drinks normally use 飲 instead.

exampleSentences.english: I have breakfast in the morning.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 sik6 zou2 caan1
